encoded_observation_overlap.scope: SCM19 training/development/clean calibration and all SCM20 pre-final roles; actual coefficient encoder input, excluding query; post-hoc diagnostic only

confidence_intervals: descriptive Wilson 95%; no multiplicity adjustment or pooled independent-seed claim

resources.memory_sampling: every forward entry and optimizer completion

selection.selected_by: seed 191 causal weights 1 and 4, steps 1000/2000/4000: preserve both development clean accuracies within .02 of the warm start; maximize worst-stratum native-minus-random fidelity, then mean difference, lower lambda, earlier step; fallback to warm start if none admissible; lambda-zero control at the selected common step; train remaining seeds only at selected lambda/step and matched zero control
